title: What got you into AI trading in the first place?
author: alphagroundhq
selftext:
Genuinely curious about this sub.

Was it a bad trade you wanted to stop repeating? Not having time to watch the market? Just liking to build things? Something you saw on Twitter?

For me it was realizing I had trading ideas I never tested, because writing the code felt like too much work.

What was yours?
